bio: We warrant that you will fall head over heels when you set foot in this pleasant restaurant. Comfort, a warm welcome and generous portions – what’s not to like? Authentic Italian recipes, mainly from Marche, come to life in familiar dishes oozing with flavour. The chef might enhance fresh al dente calamarata pasta with salsiccia and a parmesan and truffle sauce. A banquet of Italian fare! The restaurant has rapidly become a favourite with the locals – booking highly recommended....
